items.source: The value returned from the method is converted, and turned to a Message and sent through the provided MessageChannel. The message is then enriched with the session id of the input message as well as the destination from the annotation(s). If multiple destinations are specified, a copy of the message is sent to each destination.
items.translation: 方法返回的值会被转换并转换为 Message，然后通过提供的 MessageChannel 发送。随后，该消息会附加输入消息的会话 ID 以及注解中指定的目标地址。如果指定了多个目标地址，则会将消息的副本发送到每个目标地址。

items.source: By default, the prefix is set to "/topic".

items.translation: 默认情况下，前缀设置为"/queue"。
